input.title: Women's Pilates – I Have Core Issues Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I HAVE CORE ISSUES. This pilates zip up hoodie is for the woman who lives on the reformer and in the donut line right after, worn to the studio, the coffee stop and the car ride home.

On the back, a curly-haired woman in a striped leotard, a headband and yellow leg warmers lifts both legs on a pilates reformer, wobbling and laughing, with a pink donut on the floor beside it, under I HAVE in heavy capitals above and CORE ISSUES below. The lettering is pink and cream on Black and Navy and navy and berry on Ash. On the front, a rolled mat and a ball are embroidered on the left chest and the word CORE is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest mat and ball and left-cuff CORE, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

Where are the print and the embroidery on this pilates zip hoodie?
The full reformer scene and I HAVE CORE ISSUES lettering are printed across the back of this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, so the zipper never splits the art. On the front, a small embroidered rolled mat and ball sit on the left chest and CORE is stitched on the left cuff.

Is it a good gift for a pilates lover?
Yes. It suits the studio regular, the reformer beginner and anyone whose core is a running joke. Graphic Tees Co. makes each zip hoodie to order, includes one free size exchange within 30 days, and for Christmas you should order by about December 8.

How does the zip hoodie fit?
It is a regular unisex fit with a full metal zipper in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size, or go up one for a relaxed layer over studio gear. The fleece is 50% cotton and 50% polyester at 8 oz per square yard, warm enough for the walk out of a cool studio.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and fabric softener, and do not iron over the stitching. The mat and ball on the chest and the CORE cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash.

What colors does it come in?
It comes in Black, Navy and Ash. The lettering is pink and cream on Black and Navy and navy and berry on Ash, so every word stays clear, and the stitching is white thread on the dark colors and navy thread on Ash. Graphic Tees Co. makes each color to order.
